svg.title: Lattice Join
svg.desc: The lattice engine resolves profiles and facets into an effective policy, then project overrides apply.

g.text: native-gpu-systems sets memory bounds, SLSA level 3, and linters.
A security facet enforces linear history, signed commits, and security linters.
Numbers keep the minimum positive bound. Booleans keep true. Lists are deduplicated unions. Tied pins keep the first declared. ReviewMode is never joined.
ApplyOverrides keeps monotonic strictness, except for ReviewMode which can be explicitly relaxed.
The unified policy is consumed by flavor audit, invariant scans, and CI pipelines.
